purpose: Freeze the observable target vocabulary and algebraic relations needed by a future HZT perturbation derivation without supplying, fitting or inferring HZT values for mu, eta, Sigma or growth.

reference_conventions.metric: ds^2 = -(1+2 Psi) dt^2 + a^2 (1-2 Phi) delta_ij dx^i dx^j
reference_conventions.comoving_wavenumber: k in inverse comoving length; numerical unit convention may be Mpc^-1 when an observational implementation is later bound
reference_conventions.matter_variable: Delta_m denotes a reference gauge-invariant comoving matter-density contrast; its HZT parent coupling/reduction is NOT_RELEASED

mu.definition: -k^2 Psi = 4 pi G a^2 mu(k,a) rho_m Delta_m
mu.role: effective Poisson response relative to the stated reference convention

eta.role: gravitational slip in the stated reference convention
eta.domain_note: ratio requires Psi != 0; a physical HZT validity domain is NOT_RELEASED

Sigma.definition: -k^2 (Phi+Psi) = 8 pi G a^2 Sigma(k,a) rho_m Delta_m
Sigma.role: lensing response in the stated reference convention

conditions: the three observable definitions above are used with the same Phi, Psi, rho_m and Delta_m
Psi is nonzero where eta is evaluated
this is an algebraic identity of the reference interface, not an HZT prediction

optional_reference_growth_target.equation: D'' + [2 + d ln H/d ln a] D' - (3/2) Omega_m(a) mu(k,a) D = 0
assumptions: pressureless minimally coupled matter in the reference 4D description
standard matter continuity and Euler equations
quasi-static subhorizon closure sufficient to reduce the source to mu(k,a)
no additional released HZT matter-force, entropy or nonlocal source term
optional_reference_growth_target.warning: If a future parent reduction violates any assumption, this reference growth target must be replaced rather than imposed.

required_parent_derivation_sequence: select and state the released HZT-M0 parent background and matter coupling
perturb all parent metric/scalar/matter fields and derive gauge transformations
derive the complete quadratic action or equivalent linearized parent equations
derive perturbed boundary/junction conditions with orientation and provenance
classify and eliminate constraints; identify physical scalar variables
perform the controlled 6D-to-4D reduction including mode normalization and boundary response
identify Phi, Psi and Delta_m in the reduced 4D convention
derive mu(k,a), eta(k,a), Sigma(k,a) and any extra source/nonlocal terms
derive the released k,a domain, initial conditions and approximation hierarchy
implement the map and validate it independently against GR/control limits and numerical convergence
forbidden_inferences: mu=1 for Bridge because GR is the reference limit
eta=1 for Bridge because anisotropic stress was not yet derived
Sigma=1 for Bridge because a public lensing formula needs a value
the reference growth equation is a released HZT growth equation
interface QA promotes K1-D or K1-E
